list.name: target_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT target_id AS __value, target_id AS __text FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot ORDER BY target_id

list.name: queryid
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT queryid::text AS __value, queryid::text AS __text FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

list.name: priority_level
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT priority_level FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot WHERE priority_level IS NOT NULL ORDER BY priority_level

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('minute', collected_at) AS time,
       target_id || ' / ' || queryid::text AS metric,
       max(priority_score) AS priority_score
FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
  AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('minute', collected_at) AS time,
       target_id || ' / ' || queryid::text || ' mean_exec_time_ms' AS metric,
       max(mean_exec_time_ms) AS mean_exec_time_ms
FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
  AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id, queryid)
    collected_at, target_id, rank_position, queryid, priority_score, priority_level,
    reason, calls, total_exec_time_ms, mean_exec_time_ms, rows,
    share_total_time, shared_blks_read, shared_blks_hit, cache_hit_ratio, query
  FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
  WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
    AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
    AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
    AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY target_id, queryid, collected_at DESC
)
SELECT collected_at, target_id, rank_position, queryid, priority_score, priority_level,
       reason, calls, total_exec_time_ms, mean_exec_time_ms, rows,
       share_total_time, shared_blks_read, shared_blks_hit, cache_hit_ratio,
       left(query, 500) AS query_preview
FROM latest
ORDER BY priority_score DESC NULLS LAST, rank_position ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id, queryid)
       target_id, queryid, collected_at, query
FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
  AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
ORDER BY target_id, queryid, collected_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT collected_at, target_id, rank_position, queryid, priority_score, priority_level,
       reason, calls, total_exec_time_ms, mean_exec_time_ms, rows,
       shared_blks_read, temp_blks_read, temp_blks_written, cache_hit_ratio
FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
  AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
ORDER BY collected_at DESC, priority_score DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500;

SELECT collected_at, target_id, queryid, raw_payload
FROM pga_ranked_query_snapshot
WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  AND target_id IN (${target_id:sqlstring})
  AND queryid::text IN (${queryid:sqlstring})
  AND priority_level IN (${priority_level:sqlstring})
ORDER BY collected_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
